camel_example: aliyun quotas ListProductQuotas --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'q_security-groups' --Dimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --Dimensions.1.Key regionId --NextToken AAAAAd0000 --ProductCode ecs --KeyWord security --MaxResults 30 --QuotaCategory FlowControl --SortOrder Ascending --GroupCode entconsole_w1j3ms0000 --SortField TIME
description_en: Queries a list of quotas for a specified cloud product
description_zh: 查询目标云产品的配额列表
kebab_example: aliyun quotas list-product-quotas --next-token AAAAAd0000 --max-results 30 --product-code ecs --quota-action-code q_security-groups --key-word security --sort-field TIME --sort-order Ascending --dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --quota-category FlowControl --group-code entconsole_w1j3ms0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProductQuotas

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to initiate the next query.

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent query is needed.

If a subsequent query is needed, set the value to the NextToken value that is returned from the last API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records to return for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：30
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the cloud product.

For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of a cloud product, see the `ProductCode` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The keyword to use for searching quotas.

This parameter is applicable only to instance type quotas of Elastic Compute Service (ECS). The search is performed on `QuotaName` and `QuotaActionCode`
parameters.help_zh:
配额的搜索关键字。
该参数仅针对云服务器ECS规格配额（ecs-spec），搜索范围：`QuotaName`，`QuotaActionCode`
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en:
The field to use for sorting the quotas.

This parameter is applicable only to instance type quotas of ECS. If you do not set this parameter, the query results are not sorted
parameters.help_zh:
配额支持的排序方式。

该参数仅针对云服务器ECS规格配额（ecs-spec），如果不设置，则为空
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The order to sort the results.

This parameter is applicable only to instance type quotas of ECS. If you do not set this parameter, the query results are not sorted
parameters.help_zh:
配额支持的排序方式。

该参数仅针对云服务器ECS规格配额（ecs-spec），如果不设置，则为空
parameters.name: sort_order

fields.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that are supported by the cloud product
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Key。

N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the quota dimension.

The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that are supported by the cloud product
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Value。

N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The quota category.

Default value: CommonQuota
parameters.name: quota_category

parameters.help_en: The code of the dimension group
parameters.name: group_code

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned for the query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询返回的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to initiate the next query.

If this parameter is empty, no subsequent query is to be initiated.

If a value is returned, the value is the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。

如果 NextToken 为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果 NextToken 有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

Adjustable.description_en: Indicates whether the quota is adjustable

ApplicableRange.description_en: The range of the quota value that you can request for the quota. This can be used as a reference for quota increase requests
ApplicableRange.description_zh: 当前配额项可申请的配额值区间，用于配额申请时进行参考

items.description_en:
The range of the quota value that you can request.

This range does not include the existing quota of the user. You can use this as a reference when you request a quota increase. For example, `[1010,10000]`
items.description_zh:
当前配额项可申请的配额值区间。

排除当前用户已有区间，用于申请配额时进行参考，例如：`[1010,10000]`

ApplicableType.description_en: The type of the quota adjustment

ApplyReasonTips.description_en: An example of the reason for a quota increase request
ApplyReasonTips.description_zh: 申请配额调整理由示例
ApplyReasonTips.example: The business xxx is expected to grow by 50%.

Consumable.description_en: Indicates whether the used quota is displayed
Consumable.description_zh: 是否显示“已使用”的配额

EffectiveTime.description_en: The UTC time when the quota takes effect

ExpireTime.description_en: The UTC time when the quota expires

GlobalQuota.description_en: Indicates whether the quota is a global quota

Period.description_en: The calculation cycle of the quota

PeriodUnit.description_en: The unit of the calculation cycle

PeriodValue.description_en: The value of the calculation cycle

ProductCode.description_en: The abbreviation of the cloud product

QuotaArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the quota

QuotaDescription.example: The maximum number of security groups that can be owned by the current account.

SupportedRange.description_en: The range of the quota value that is supported by the quota. This can be used as a reference when you configure a quota template
SupportedRange.description_zh: 当前配额项支持的配额值区间，用于配置配额模板时进行参考

items.description_en:
The range of the quota value that is supported by the quota. This can be used as a reference when you configure a quota template.

If ApplicableType is continuous, and the value is [1009,10000], it indicates that all values from 1009 to 10000 are supported.

If ApplicableType is discontinuous, and the value is [10,20,50,100], it indicates that only the values 10, 20, 50, and 100 are supported
items.description_zh:
当前配额项支持的配额值区间，用于配置配额模板时进行参考。

当ApplicableType为continuous时，如果取值为[1009,10000]，则表示取值为1009~10000中的所有数。

当ApplicableType为discontinuous时，如果取值为[10,20,50,100]，则表示取值仅为10、20、50和100

UnadjustableDetail.description_en: The reason why the quota is not adjustable

UsageMetric.description_en:
The monitoring information of the quota usage in CloudMonitor.

An empty value indicates that no monitoring data is available for the quota in CloudMonitor
UsageMetric.description_zh:
配额用量在云监控（CloudMonitor）中的监控信息。

空表示云监控中无此配额监控数据

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of the dimension for CloudMonitor

MetricDimensions.description_en:
The dimensions for CloudMonitor.

Format: a collection of key-value pairs. For example:
`{"productCode":"***","metricKey":"***","regionId":"***","label":"***"}`
MetricDimensions.description_zh:
CloudMonitor监控维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：
`{"productCode":"***","metricKey":"***","regionId":"***","label":"***"}`

MetricName.description_en: The name of the CloudMonitor metric

MetricNamespace.description_en: The namespace of the metric for CloudMonitor

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records returned for the request
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求返回的全部记录条数
